name: 手持单物
description: 角色单手持/握一个小物件（梨/球/石头/信封等），手与物接触

generation.promptTemplate: {characterAnchor}, holding {propAnchor} in one hand at chest height, fingers visibly wrapped around the object, object clearly in hand (not floating, not on ground), natural grip, {expressionHint}
generation.negativeExtra: object floating, object on ground, object without hand, hand empty, object behind body

placement.note: 载体变体替换，道具不单独摆位

acceptance: 物在角色手中（非浮空/落地）
物的朝向/数量与剧情一致
角色表情与剧情情绪一致
